iterationLog.note: Per Sections 21/22's anti-gaming discipline (carried forward from Phase 3F.1.5.2), no fix here ever loosened the new I_CLAIM_IDENTITY dimension or any threshold; every fix below corrected a test-authoring inaccuracy in the synthetic fixture text, verified against the evaluator's actual, unmodified decision logic.

corrections.issue: Expectation asserted credited:true for a matchStatus=PARTIAL result; PARTIAL is never in the CREDITED set (only EXACT_SINGLE/EXACT_COMPOSITE) by this suite's own convention (mirrors safe-surfacing-calibration.test.ts). Corrected to credited:false, allowedMatchStatuses:['PARTIAL'].

Candidate paraphrase used 'may dispose' (permissive framing) against a GT drafted as a bare noun-phrase description with no deontic marker, triggering an unrelated INVERTED_LEGAL_POSTURE conflict unconnected to the sibling-identity fix. Rewrote both GT and candidate with consistent 'No Loan Party will Dispose...except in the ordinary course' RESTRICTIVE framing, matching the already-proven pattern from Phase 3F.1.5.2's SS-series tests.

Both GT and candidates were drafted as bare noun-phrases ('Restricted Payments not to exceed...') with no explicit action verb, causing gtActions to resolve empty and tripping the SOLE_DIMENSION_OBJECT_THRESHOLD bar (Phase 3F.1.5.2's own prior fix) on short split candidates. Rewrote with an explicit 'No Loan Party will make Restricted Payments...' action-bearing verb, consistent with realistic drafting and with how the SOLE_DIMENSION threshold is calibrated to behave.

combinedSuiteResult: 117/117 tests passing across all 7 evaluation-v2 test files (95 pre-existing from Phase 3F.1.5.2 + 22 new sibling-claim cases).
